dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's called Loy Krathong. It's on the night of the full moon in November.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈkɔːld ˈlɔɪ krəˈtɔːŋ. ɪts ɑːn ðə ˈnaɪt əv ðə ˌfʊl ˈmuːn ɪn noʊˈvɛmbər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: What are those little boats on the river?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt ər ðoʊz ˈlɪtəl ˈboʊts ɑːn ðə ˈrɪvər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: They're called krathongs. People decorate them with flowers and candles.
dialogue.reading: ðɛr ˈkɔːld krəˈtɔːŋz. ˈpiːpəl ˈdɛkəreɪt ðɛm wɪð ˈflaʊərz ənd ˈkændəlz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And what do people do with them?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈwʌt duː ˈpiːpəl ˈduː wɪð ðɛm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: They float them on the river to say thank you to the water.
dialogue.reading: ðeɪ ˈfloʊt ðɛm ɑːn ðə ˈrɪvər tə ˈseɪ ˈθæŋk juː tə ðə ˈwɔːtər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: What are those lights in the sky?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt ər ðoʊz ˈlaɪts ɪn ðə ˈskaɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: They're called lanterns. In Chiang Mai, people send them into the sky.
dialogue.reading: ðɛr ˈkɔːld ˈlæntərnz. ɪn ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ, ˈpiːpəl ˈsɛnd ðɛm ˈɪntuː ðə ˈskaɪ.
